title: Deposit Operations Measurement Standard: The Sum a Certificate of Deposit Penalty Is Charged On
content:
The sum a penalty is charged on is not in every case the sum the withdrawal removes. Recent crediting on the certificate, and principal already taken out of it, are measured first.

## The measure

The basis is graded: where interest has been credited to the certificate in the one month counted back from the day the principal leaves and the rate of the term now running stands above the tier's published standard interest rate, the basis is the sum the withdrawal removes less the interest credited in that one month; where principal was already taken out by an earlier partial withdrawal in the twelve months before this one and no interest has been credited in that one month, the basis is the sum the withdrawal removes together with that earlier principal; otherwise the basis is the sum the withdrawal removes.

## The two windows

The first window is the one month counted back from the day the principal leaves, and what is measured in it is the interest credited to the certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line. The second is the twelve months before this withdrawal, and what is measured in it is the principal taken out by earlier partial withdrawals. Neither window is a calendar month or a calendar year; each runs back from the day the principal leaves.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Interest credited in the one month counted back | The term's rate against the tier's published standard rate | Earlier partial withdrawals in the twelve months before | The basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| some | above it | any | the sum removed, less the interest credited in that one month |
| some | at it or below it | any | the sum removed |
| none | any | one or more | the sum removed, together with that earlier principal |
| none | any | none | the sum removed |

The second grade is reached only where nothing was credited in that one month; where something was credited but the rate does not stand above the published figure, the basis is simply the sum removed.

## Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

A withdrawal removes 12000.00 USD. In the one month counted back from that day, 141.20 USD of interest was credited, and the term now running carries 4.05 percent against a published standard rate of 3.97 percent for the tier. The rate stands above the published figure, so the basis is 12000.00 less 141.20, or 11858.80 USD.

A withdrawal removes 12000.00 USD; nothing was credited in that one month, and 5000.00 USD of principal was taken out by an earlier partial withdrawal within the twelve months before. The basis is 12000.00 together with 5000.00, or 17000.00 USD.

A withdrawal removes 12000.00 USD from a certificate on which nothing was credited in that one month and from which nothing had been taken before. The basis is 12000.00 USD.
